name: Brianna Ellis
bio:
Brianna's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, sparked by a statistics project during her mathematics degree at MIT. Analyzing historical race data, she discovered a passion for extracting meaningful insights from complex datasets. After graduating, she honed her skills at a financial modeling firm before making the leap to motorsport, driven by a desire to apply her analytical abilities to a field she truly loved.

At Eurofarma RC, Brianna is known for her meticulous approach and ability to identify subtle performance advantages. She focuses on translating raw data into actionable strategies for the team's engineers and drivers. Her dedication extends beyond the numbers; she believes in fostering a collaborative environment where data-driven insights complement the experience and intuition of the entire team. Brianna distinguishes herself by creating custom visualizations that bring complex data to life, ensuring that everyone understands the implications of her analysis.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, usually tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Brianna is of average height with a focused, yet friendly demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a lucky abacus for pre-race calculations.
Has a habit of color-coding her spreadsheets with motorsport-themed colors.
Drinks copious amounts of green tea throughout the day.
